At this moment, period and time will not exist, and years and hours will disappear.

ai.seo_question: What happens to God after the world ends according to Shia theology?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) articulates the concept of *Baqa'* (eternity) by contrasting it with *Fana'* (annihilation), asserting that while the universe is contingent and bound by time and space, Allah remains the Self-Sufficient (*Al-Samad*) beyond all temporal constraints. This reflects the Shia theological emphasis on Allah's absolute independence (*Ghani*) and the total dependence of creation (*Faqr*), where the world's endurance relies solely on His will rather than any intrinsic power within the created order. The description of Allah as 'Al-Qahhar' (The Dominant) underscores His sovereignty over the transition from non-existence to existence and back to non-existence.
